newsitem.title: DUBAI: Swiss team in UAE to probe fake watch trade.
newsitem.headline: Swiss team in UAE to probe fake watch trade.

text.p: Swiss watchmakers have launched a investigation into Gulf imports of fake watches from east Asian manufacturers, a United Arab Emirates newspaper said on Sunday.

Gulf News quoted officials from the Federation of the Swiss Watch Industry as saying they had found enough fake watches in the UAE emirate of Dubai to begin an investigation into the magnitude of what has become a global problem.
"Now we have to determine if the problem is large enough to start action," Jean Daniel Pasche, federation director in charge of running the anti-fake campaign, told the daily.
The federation, which has focused mainly on fighting counterfeit watches in Asia, has spent millions of dollars on combating the worldwide problem.
It identifies the origin of the problem, asks authorities to seize the imitated or pirated items and takes violators to court.
